integrity: Mathematical proof and standalone finite checks assessed together. No external or independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: This is a statement about individual central elements of the finite type-A 0-Hecke monoid, not the linear center of a 0-Hecke algebra or other Coxeter types. The general proof is self-contained apart from the standard Demazure multiplication description; finite computations check degrees through eight but are not infinite proofs. Earlier general parabolic-multiplication theorems subsume the product-law component; historical priority of the complete centrality classification remains provisional.
title: The full center of the type-A 0-Hecke monoid is a truncated monogenic monoid
